name: com.valentinchik.editor-controls
description: Companion package for the Editor Controls for Unity plugin for Logi Options+ (MX Keypad, MX Creative Console, Actions Ring). Shows live editor state on your keys — play mode, compilation, console errors, active tool, tests — runs actions even while Unity is in the background, fills the plugin's folders with your scenes, layouts, tools and assets, and drives MX Master 4 haptics.
